description:
A property-based test, with a contract-valid generator, asserts that `plan_hash` is invariant under permutation of a delta's action-set input order.

## Background

The plan-derivation core of the repository-materialization subsystem has no property-based coverage of `plan_hash` determinism (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/image.rs`). Because `RepositoryDelta::new` sorts its input and rejects duplicates, reordering is a boundary phenomenon that a property test can pin.

The generator produces distinct-path action sets: a `btree_set` of `VirtualPath` mapped to actions whose preimage matches the kind per `validate_action`, with a path-derived unique `EntryIdentity` so the physical-alias check is cleared. The oracle permutes the input order, builds two deltas through `RepositoryDelta::new`, and asserts `plan_hash` equality across the permutations. A discriminating half of the generator asserts that `plan_hash` equality holds if and only if the two normalized deltas are equal, so the test cannot pass by collapsing distinct inputs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A `proptest` generator produces only contract-valid action sets (action preimages matching their kind, with unique `EntryIdentity`).
- [hard] REQ-02: A property test asserts `plan_hash` is invariant under permutation of the action-set input order, built through `RepositoryDelta::new`.
- [hard] REQ-03: A discriminating case ties `plan_hash` equality to normalized-delta equality, so collapsing distinct inputs cannot make the test pass.

## Notes

Assert observable semantic properties rather than exact hash values or copied constants. The test lives in an in-crate test module and adds no integration-test target.
title: Plan-hash reorder-invariance property test
